verdict.rationale: Modal documents turning any function into a scalable HTTPS endpoint, which partly covers serving applications from compute. The evidence never mentions arbitrary port exposure from a container or sandbox, and says nothing about private networking between instances. missing for 10: explicit port exposure/tunneling from instances, private networking between containers or sandboxes, in-depth docs and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can expose ports to serve applications from my instance and connect instances over private networking

citations.quote: Turn any function into an HTTPS endpoint that scales with traffic and idles at zero.
